title: IAF (Integrated Architecture Framework) and the alternatives

videos.script: TOGAF tells you what steps to take. It says much less about how to think through one architecture, from the reason for a change down to the products that deliver it. {{title}} IAF, Capgemini's Integrated Architecture Framework, is built around exactly that. {{iaf}} It asks four questions in order. Why. What. How. With what. {{levels}} And it asks them of four areas. Business, information, information systems and technology. {{areas}} This lesson takes Carcará's digital boarding through that grid. Then it shows ArchiMate, the notation enterprise architects use to draw all of this in one language. {{archimate}} And it ends with the other frameworks you will meet, from the American government's to NATO's, and a way to choose between them.
